lesson_body: Great job on your first day! Today on Day 2, we are expanding our counting path up to the number 10. Once we pass five, we keep moving forward: six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Grouping objects into collections of ten is a special mathematical trick that helps us count massive piles of things very quickly without getting lost.
interactive_assignment: Gather ten crayons or markers. Separate them into two equal piles of five. Count the first pile, then continue counting through the second pile until you reach ten.
daily_assessment: Count the total number of fingers on both of your hands combined. Write the final numerical digits in your tracking workspace panel.
